top_insights: Zero rollbacks across 4 waves demonstrates the regression-gate strategy is effective. Typecheck + test gates caught issues before they propagated.
Wave 1-2 execution during earlier phases already applied 11 of 15 PRD evolution candidates, showing the audit-execute-PRD loop is working as designed.
Medium/Low finding counts reduced dramatically during triage (350->138, 250->16) suggesting proportional severity (Proposal #6) should be adopted to prevent count inflation at source.
The 107-sub-agent architecture produced deep findings but also significant duplication across compound domains (D16 re-reporting D3/D5/D7 findings). Proposal #5 (auto-dedup for D16) addresses this.
D12 (Observability) remains the lowest-scoring domain (60 post-execution) because the checklist measures runtime observability inappropriate for a CLI tool. Proposal #4 recalibration is recommended.
Test count increased by 59% (+645 tests) during execution, indicating significant test infrastructure gaps were addressed. Future cycles should see smaller test additions if quality is maintained.
Documentation fixes had 100% success rate, suggesting docs-type findings are consistently well-specified and straightforward to resolve.
The competitive landscape analysis (D17) identified existential distribution gap. Open-sourcing and npm publish are now the highest-priority strategic items.
